name: model-refresh-6
title: Six-brand production refresh — post facts/reputation split
subtitle: Two waves of the working-tree pipeline run in-process against six live brands: the facts/descriptions split, the expansion→reputation rename, deferred locations, and per-call LLM cost tracking.
warning: Run in-process from the main working tree on 2026-08-03, NOT the deployed Railway worker. Wave 1 (Entadar, Heyyou Moment, Littdlework) classified images five per call; wave 2 (Robber 925 Silver, RESHOCK COFFEE, WEAVISM) ran with BATCH_SIZE 10 and MAX_CHUNK_RETRIES 2. Per-brand cost is therefore comparable within a wave, not across the two.
